## What's the use case?
What are you trying to build, and where does the current API fall short?

## Proposed API
A sketch of what this might look like (a new parameter, widget, or method).
Doesn't need to be final — the shape of the idea is what matters most.

## Have you checked the workarounds?
Many things are already possible via existing builder hooks
(`bubbleBuilder`, `customBubbleBuilder`, `resultRenderers`, `sendOrMicBuilder`,
`inputLeadingBuilder`, etc.) or the [cookbook](../../doc/cookbook/README.md).
If you tried one and it didn't work, say what happened.

## Additional context
Anything else — links, screenshots of similar UIs elsewhere, etc.
